summary: WSC Group is a Sydney-headquartered accounting and advisory firm (property investment tax, business advice, SMSF) with a Docklands, Melbourne office. It is majority-owned by ASX-listed Count Limited and agreed in August 2026 to merge with CountPlus One. It was named 2026 Count Firm of the Year. Client Manager and executive committee member Jonathan Karanikas leads its not-for-profit accounting and assurance work.

hooks.text: Jonathan leads NFP accounting and assurance for a large charity portfolio, so client-book reconciliation volume sits with him; WSC's recent Count Firm of the Year award gives a natural opener.
Merger with CountPlus One increases client books to keep current; WSC's own article says software can help automate monthly reporting.
Budgeting and forecasting is a published theme for Jonathan; faster reconciliation feeds it.

risks.text: Majority-owned by ASX-listed Count Limited (about 58.7% from July 2026, around 70.2% post merger): software and process decisions may be set at network level; Count has standardised Xero-based stacks across firms.
Recent merger with CountPlus One means integration priorities; contacts and roles may change.
Primary contact on the account record is Emily Delandro, an executive assistant and not a decision-maker (account notes), so the draft goes to Jonathan Karanikas instead.
Property tax and SMSF focus with limited bookkeeping signal; weak-to-moderate fit per account notes.

gaps: No podcast, Facebook or Instagram content found for Jonathan Karanikas.
No current job ads found on the WSC careers page (it links to a vacancies list not retrieved).
Jonathan's own blog posts date from 2021-2023; no recent LinkedIn posts found.
Title discrepancy: WSC page says Client Manager, LinkedIn headline says Manager; account record says Associate Principal.
